questions.stem: What is the term used for a number that divides another number and leaves no remainder?
questions.solution: A number that divides another number and leaves no remainder is called a factor. The term 'Factor' is correct because it refers to a number that can divide another number evenly. 'Multiple' is the result of multiplying a number by an integer, 'Dividend' is the number being divided, and 'Remainder' is what is left after division.

questions.stem: What is the least common multiple (LCM) of 6 and 8?
questions.solution: The least common multiple of 6 and 8 is 24 because it is the smallest number that both 6 and 8 can divide into without leaving a remainder. 12 is a common multiple but not the least, and 18 and 36 are not divisible by both 6 and 8.

hi.stem: 6 और 8 का लघुत्तम समापवर्तक (LCM) क्या है?
hi.solution: 6 और 8 का लघुत्तम समापवर्तक 24 है क्योंकि यह वह सबसे छोटी संख्या है जिसमें 6 और 8 दोनों बिना शेष के विभाजित हो जाते हैं। 12 एक सामान्य समापवर्तक है लेकिन सबसे कम नहीं है, और 18 और 36 दोनों 6 और 8 दोनों द्वारा विभाजित नहीं होते हैं।

questions.stem: What is the smallest number that is divisible by 8, 12 and 16?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 48. The LCM of 8, 12, and 16 is calculated by taking the product of the common and uncommon prime factors. The prime factors of 8 are 2×2×2, of 12 are 2×2×3, and of 16 are 2×2×2×2. The common factors are 2×2, and the uncommon factors are 2×3. So, LCM = 2×2×2×2×3 = 48. Option 24 is too small, option 72 and 96 are larger than the LCM.

hi.stem: 8, 12 और 16 से विभाज्य सबसे छोटी संख्या क्या है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 48 है। 8, 12 और 16 का ल.स.प. हम उभयनिष्ठ और अनुभयनिष्ठ अभाज्य गुणनखंडों के गुणनफल लेकर निकालते हैं। 8 के अभाज्य गुणनखंड 2×2×2 हैं, 12 के अभाज्य गुणनखंड 2×2×3 हैं, और 16 के अभाज्य गुणनखंड 2×2×2×2 हैं। उभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड 2×2 हैं, और अनुभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड 2×3 हैं। अतः ल.स.प. = 2×2×2×2×3 = 48। विकल्प 24 बहुत छोटा है, विकल्प 72 और 96 ल.स.प. से बड़े हैं।

questions.stem: The LCM of two numbers is 200 and the GCD is 10. If one of the numbers is 40, what is the other number?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 50. Using the formula: product of numbers = GCD × LCM, the product is 10 × 200 = 2000. If one number is 40, then the other number = 2000 ÷ 40 = 50. Option 20 is too small, option 30 is incorrect because 40 × 30 = 1200, not 2000, and option 60 is also incorrect because 40 × 60 = 2400, not 2000.

hi.stem: दो संख्याओं का ल.स. 200 है और म.स. 10 है। यदि एक संख्या 40 है, तो दूसरी संख्या क्या है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 50 है। सूत्र: संख्याओं का गुणनफल = म.स. × ल.स. का उपयोग करके, गुणनफल 10 × 200 = 2000 है। यदि एक संख्या 40 है, तो दूसरी संख्या = 2000 ÷ 40 = 50। विकल्प 20 बहुत छोटा है, विकल्प 30 गलत है क्योंकि 40 × 30 = 1200, 2000 नहीं है, और विकल्प 60 भी गलत है क्योंकि 40 × 60 = 2400, 2000 नहीं है।

questions.stem: A garland seller has 48 red roses and 60 white roses. He wants to make garlands with the same number of flowers in each. What is the maximum number of flowers in each garland?
questions.solution: The maximum number of flowers in each garland is the GCD of 48 and 60. The GCD of 48 and 60 is 12. 6, 24, and 30 are not the greatest common divisors of 48 and 60 because they do not divide both numbers evenly.
